items.title: Predator Spyware Sample Indicates 'Vendor-Controlled' C2
items.description: Researchers detailed how Intellexa, Predator's owner, uses failed deployments and thwarted infections to strengthen its commercial spyware and generate more effective attacks.

items.title: AWS CodeBuild Misconfiguration Exposed GitHub Repos to Potential Supply Chain Attacks
